faqs.question: Is everything online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inspire College offers 100% online qualifications and professional courses. Classes, materials and recordings live in Inspire Brain, our student portal.

faqs.question: Is this a recognised qualification?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our HNDs and Foundation programmes are awarded by ATHE, an Ofqual-regulated UK awarding organisation, with routes to UK top-up degrees.

faqs.question: Are the qualifications recognised?
faqs.answer: Our HNDs and Foundation programmes are awarded by ATHE, an Ofqual-regulated UK awarding organisation, with routes to UK top-up degrees. We also partner with WINC, LSBF, Jain University and the CPD Certification Service.

faqs.question: How will I know how my child is doing?
faqs.answer: With your child’s consent, a parent view in Inspire Brain shows attendance, grades and upcoming deadlines, and advisors are a WhatsApp message away.

faqs.question: Can I pay in instalments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pay in full, or spread your fee into monthly instalments with secure PayHere payment links. Registration starts from LKR 9,500. Try the fee planner above.

faqs.question: Can we pay monthly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pay in full or in monthly instalments by PayHere link. Registration starts from LKR 9,500, and the first 20 students receive a LKR 200,000 scholarship.

faqs.question: How does the free coffee work?
faqs.answer: Enrolled CPD UK and ATHE students get one free coffee a week at participating Barista cafés during Inspire Hours, Monday to Friday daytime: 4 a month, 48 a year.

faqs.question: Who teaches the classes?
faqs.answer: Live online sessions are led by Sri Lankan lecturers who hold relevant master’s degrees, with recordings in the student portal.

faqs.question: What happens after I apply?
faqs.answer: We review your application, an advisor contacts you, we confirm your entry requirements and you complete enrolment.

faqs.question: What happens after we apply?
faqs.answer: We review the application, an advisor contacts you, we confirm entry requirements and you complete enrolment together.
